items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, that was in 1924, '23 and '24, when I was playing there because I left late in 1924.

ctx.x: Well, that was in 1924, '23 and '24, when I was playing there because I left late in 1924.
Now, had you heard King Oliver's band, because they made some first recordings?
The first record I made was for him.
